newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Jan 22.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Jan 22.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
- President Jiang Zemin says government by law not only good for civilisation and progress but also long-term stability.
- Premier Li Peng says Sino-Japanese relations need greater care and responsibility and for difficulties in relationship in 1996 did not rest with China.
- China's auditors seizes 203.8 billion in illegal funds in 1996.
- Southern China's Hainan province sets up natural gas and fertiliser factory.
- China Aerospace Corp to intensify cooperation in world market.
- Hong Kong's existing laws continue to be reviewed and those contradictory to basic law to be abolished.
- China places importance on relationship with Vanuatu.
- China has sent 270,000 people to study abroad, 90,000 have returned.
- Minister of China's Economic and Trade Commission says reform of state firms will deepen in 1997.
